falcon_tube.description: 15 mL Falcon tube for PCR Master Mix

dilution_tube.description: Small tube for 1:100 SYBR G dilution

master_mix_plate.description: Green 96-well microplate for master mix and samples (PCR plate)

steps.notes: Water is added to the Falcon tube; source well notation is nominal as this is a tube rack with a single vessel.
297 uL PCR Water added to the small dilution tube first, before SYBR G, to prepare 1:100 dilution.
3 uL SYBR G added to the dilution tube containing PCR water to achieve 1:100 dilution.
Vortex and spin down the dilution tube to homogenize the SYBR G 1:100 dilution.
Primer 1 added to the Falcon tube; source notation is nominal for a tube rack.
Primer 2 added to the Falcon tube; source notation is nominal for a tube rack.
Protocol says '5\' mix' which is interpreted as 5x master mix; confirm correct reagent name.
Quick vortex and spin down the Falcon tube to homogenize the complete master mix.

steps.instrument_action: Thaw and spin down the extracted DNA sample plate to ensure samples are fully dissolved and collected at the bottom of wells.
steps.notes: Thawing is a manual/offline step; centrifuge speed and duration were not specified.

steps.instrument_action: Seal PCR plate with plastic film and spin down to eliminate bubbles and ensure liquid is at the bottom of each well.
steps.notes: Centrifuge speed and duration for plate spin-down were not specified.

steps.instrument_action: Run qPCR using the hsp60 qPCR 25 uL 40-cycle program on the sealed PCR plate.
steps.notes: Exact thermocycler program parameters (temperatures, ramp rates, annealing temps) were not provided in the protocol.
